headline: Sanofi to Acquire Insmed to Strengthen Immunology and Rare Disease Portfolio
summary: Sanofi announced it will acquire Insmed in a strategic move that adds two first-in-disease commercialized products and pipeline assets, bolstering its long-term growth outlook in immunology and rare diseases.
why: M&A activity in the pharmaceutical sector reshapes competitive landscapes, portfolio valuations, and future revenue streams for large drugmakers.
